title: Pocketwire Advance Extension Allowances — Desk Quick Reference
content:
Pocketwire Advance offers two kinds of due-date extension, a standard extension and a hardship extension. The allowances of each tier are these.

## Standard extension

| Tier | Standard extension available | Days added to the due date | Fee (USD) | Per advance | Per calendar year on the line | Consecutive on-time repayments needed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | No | 7 | 1.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | Yes | 7 | 1.00 | 1 | 2 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | Yes | 14 | 0.00 | 1 | 3 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | Yes | 14 | 0.00 | 1 | 3 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | Yes | 14 | 0.00 | 2 | 4 | 0 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | Yes | 21 | 0.00 | 2 | 6 | 0 |

The fee of a standard extension is booked as a 0.00 entry on tiers without a fee. The days are calendar days.

## Hardship extension

| Tier | Days added to the due date | Hardship extensions per calendar year |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Advance Starter | 14 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Basic | 14 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Standard | 14 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Plus | 21 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Max | 21 | 1 |
| Pocketwire Advance Elite | 30 | 1 |

## Quick reading

- Pocketwire Advance Starter shows "No" for the standard extension; the hardship extension columns apply to it like every other tier.
- On Pocketwire Advance Basic a standard extension adds 7 calendar days for a fee of 1.00; from Pocketwire Advance Standard upward it carries a fee of 0.00.
- Pocketwire Advance Max and Pocketwire Advance Elite need 0 consecutive on-time repayments for a standard extension.
